text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: restrictive particle opening a whole-clause identity claim; emphasis and exclusion are both active
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّمَا}} ({{tr:innamā}}) opens the ayah by restricting the whole nominal equation, so brotherhood is not one trait among others but the defining predicate for the believers. Its fused particle form makes exclusion and emphasis operate as one compact scope marker. The ayah therefore begins with identity before command, moving from restricted brotherhood to repair and then to the hope of mercy after the procedural conflict frame of 49:9.

topics.headline: restrictive identity scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believer-brotherhood is asserted as the restricted identity of the group, not as a loose moral description.
topics.reason: The particle is syntactically scoped over the nominal clause, and no guardrail evidence weakens the restrictive reading.

topics.headline: fused restriction operator
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the written and recited unit functions as one compact restriction operator rather than as ordinary governance by a separable particle.
topics.reason: The inna-plus-ma analysis supports a compact whole-clause operator while local grammar blocks ordinary inna governance.

topics.headline: declaration before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not start by ordering repair; it first names the identity from which repair follows after the procedural scene of 49:9.
topics.reason: Opening position and boundary evidence support the movement from declaration to repair to mercy.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active participle naming the believer class as the subject of the restricted identity clause
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, safety, and security-making remain relevant as root pressure, while the local word functions as the definite believer class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muʾminūna}}) names the already-recognized believer class inside the restriction, not an incidental group. As a definite plural active participle from {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}), it lets faith carry trust and safety-making pressure: the community defined by belief is expected to make brothers safe from rupture. Its surah-local role ties identity to conduct, especially the repair command and the God-oriented command that follow.

topics.headline: known class under restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restricted claim targets the whole known believer class as a nominal identity, not a one-time event or sample case.
topics.reason: The nominative definite plural is the subject under the restrictive particle, with brotherhood as its predicate.

topics.headline: faith as safety-making identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the believer-name carries safety, trust, and security pressure, while the local sense remains the believing community.
topics.reason: The root family supports safety and trust pressure, but the local surface is the active participial believer label, not an independent abstract noun for security.

topics.headline: ongoing communal conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is presented as an ongoing communal status tested by repair and divine orientation rather than as a generic label.
topics.reason: The participial form, plural morphology, root pairings, and same-surah recurrence support identity moving into commanded conduct.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative predicate assigning close siblinghood as the category of believer identity
words.root_gloss_range: kinship, brotherhood, companionship, and shared-condition senses are narrowed here to intimate sibling identity by the predicate role and plural choice

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby governed dual brother noun referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:إِخْوَةٌ}} ({{tr:ikhwatun}}) completes the restricted equation as an indefinite nominative predicate: believers are assigned the category of siblinghood itself. The chosen broken plural keeps the payoff close and kinship-heavy rather than broad fellowship, while {{ar:أ خ و}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-w}}) later returns in {{ar:أَخَوَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:akhawaykum}}), narrowing communal brotherhood into the concrete pair that must be reconciled. The word also begins the kinship frame answered by the mercy close.

topics.headline: brotherhood as predicate category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that brotherhood is assigned as a category of identity, not pointed to as one known subgroup.
topics.reason: The nominative indefinite predicate role makes siblinghood the clause's classifying identity content.

topics.headline: close siblinghood over loose fellowship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word pulls the social bond toward close sibling kinship, while broader companion senses are not the selected local payoff.
topics.reason: The root range includes broader relations, but the restrictive predicate and selected plural support the closer sibling reading.

topics.headline: kinship arc into mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brotherhood predicate is carried into the later dual and then answered by the mercy close, instead of functioning as an isolated label.
topics.reason: The local root reprise, same-surah echoes, and closure rows support a movement from sibling identity to concrete repair to mercy.

words.gloss_range: consequential conjunction attaching the repair imperative to the preceding identity claim

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby repair imperative referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the first hinge of the ayah: it makes repair follow from believer-brotherhood as a consequence, not as an unrelated instruction. Because it is fused onto {{ar:أَصْلِحُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṣliḥū}}), the surface itself makes the turn from identity to action immediate. Its contrast with the later {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) matters: repair branches causally from brotherhood, while taqwa is coordinated beside repair as a companion duty.

topics.headline: identity entails repair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reconciliation is grammatically entailed by brotherhood rather than merely advised after it.
topics.reason: The fa before the imperative is licensed as the result link from the restrictive identity clause.

topics.headline: attached consequence-command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the consequence is heard as an immediate attached command at the surface.
topics.reason: The particle is attached to the imperative and marks the pivot from being to obligation.

topics.headline: fa versus wa architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah distinguishes a causal branch into repair from the later coordinated move into taqwa, while 49:9 supplies the procedural boundary behind the shift.
topics.reason: The row evidence explicitly contrasts fa with wa and links the current fa to the boundary from ayah 9 procedure.

words.gloss_range: Form IV plural imperative commanding active repair or making sound, locally completed by the between-brothers phrase rather than by a direct object
words.root_gloss_range: soundness, goodness, repair, reform, and settlement are narrowed here to causative relational repair

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local governed phrase referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْلِحُوا۟}} ({{tr:aṣliḥū}}) is not a vague call to be good; as a Form IV plural imperative from {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}), it commands the community to produce soundness where rupture has occurred. Its complement is {{ar:بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:bayna akhawaykum}}), so the damaged relation, not either brother as a direct object, is the repair target. The same imperative from 49:9 is now reframed by explicit brotherhood, moving from legal conflict handling to identity-based reconciliation.

topics.headline: community repairs the relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole addressed community is commanded to repair the relation between brothers, not simply to fix one disputant.
topics.reason: The plural imperative has the believers as its implicit subject and is completed by the bayna phrase rather than a direct object.

topics.headline: making sound what is broken
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's soundness field becomes active as causative relational repair, not as generic righteousness.
topics.reason: The local bayna complement selects active reconciliation and structural restoration from the broader soundness/goodness range.

topics.headline: 49:9 command reframed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same repair root crosses from 49:9 procedure into 49:10 brotherhood, making repair the local spine of the transition.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence, boundary rows, and paired-imperative structure support a reframing rather than a new unrelated command.

words.gloss_range: locative relational adverb governing the following genitive dual and naming the interval to be repaired
words.root_gloss_range: between-space, separation, distinction, clarity, and explanation are narrowed here to the relational interval, with clarity/separation as supporting pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby coordinated imperative phrase referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}) turns the command into repair of an interval: a governed relational space between two brothers. The root {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) carries separation and clarity, so the phrase does not erase the two endpoints; it repairs the space that distinguishes and connects them. Across the boundary from 49:9, the earlier dual interval is reidentified as a brother-space, and the phrase closes the first imperative before the ayah resumes with {{ar:وَٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:wa-ittaqū}}).

topics.headline: between-space as repair locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of repair is a relational interval treated almost as a place.
topics.reason: Bayna governs the following genitive dual and functions as the adverbial complement of the repair command.

topics.headline: separation and connection together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repair preserves the two endpoints while healing the space between them, with clarity and separation coloring the interval.
topics.reason: The local surface selects interval, while the broader root field supplies clarity and separation pressure without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: faction interval renamed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conflict interval from 49:9 is carried forward and renamed as the space between brothers.
topics.reason: The same-surah, boundary, phrase-boundary, and sound rows support a shift from factional interval to fraternal interval.

words.gloss_range: genitive dual brother noun with second-person plural possessive suffix, governed by the between-space
words.root_gloss_range: brotherhood and kinship field narrowed here to a concrete dyad belonging to the addressed community, while plural variant pressure preserves broader applicability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier brotherhood predicate referenced in prose
nearby relational adverb referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:أَخَوَيْكُمْ}} ({{tr:akhawaykum}}) is the narrowing pivot: communal {{ar:إِخْوَةٌ}} ({{tr:ikhwatun}}) becomes the concrete dual pair whose relation needs repair. The plural suffix makes them your two brothers, belonging grammatically to the addressed community, while the genitive relation keeps them as endpoints of {{ar:بَيْنَ}} ({{tr:bayna}}), not direct objects of the verb. Variant plural pressures widen applicability, but the local surface still makes the smallest conflict unit visible.

topics.headline: your two brothers as endpoints
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two brothers belong to the addressed community and define the repair-space as endpoints, not as the verb's direct object.
topics.reason: The genitive dual is governed by bayna, and the 2mp possessive suffix points to the same addressed believers who receive the command.

topics.headline: dual tested by plural variants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scale shift from communal brotherhood to any two brothers, while accepted variant pressure keeps broader conflict scales visible.
topics.reason: The canonical surface remains dual, but variant rows are useful as scale pressure rather than replacement of the local parse.

topics.headline: brother root carries across
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same brother root moves from identity to repair-target and renames the two factions of 49:9 as brothers.
topics.reason: Root echo, construct morphology, collocation, and boundary evidence converge on the narrowing from class to pair.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction attaching the second imperative to the repair command without making it a causal result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby coordinated imperative phrase referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second imperative joined to the first while changing the axis of attention. Unlike {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), it does not make taqwa the consequence of repair; it coordinates God-conscious self-shielding beside reconciliation as a twin duty. The fused surface {{ar:وَٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:wa-ittaqū}}) makes the continuation immediate rather than a detached maxim.

topics.headline: joined twin command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that taqwa is coordinated with reconciliation as a companion duty, not left as a detached closing slogan.
topics.reason: The waw joins the second imperative to the first without creating a causal subordination.

topics.headline: social to divine pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the immediate pivot from repairing relations among brothers to orienting that repair before God.
topics.reason: The fused conjunction and second imperative mark a quick axis shift inside one ethical sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII plural imperative of self-shielding or protective God-consciousness, taking the divine name as direct object/reference point
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, prevention, and taqwa are narrowed here to reflexive moral self-protection oriented toward God

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following divine object referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّقُوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqū}}) adds a protective discipline to the repair command. Its Form VIII shape from {{ar:و ق ي}} ({{tr:w-q-y}}) makes the command self-shielding rather than passive fear, and the direct object {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) fixes God as the reference axis. After repairing the between-space, the community is told to maintain a moral barrier against renewed rupture, and the clause points forward into the hope of being shown mercy.

topics.headline: self-shielding before God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same community commanded to repair is commanded to shield itself with God as the direct reference axis, not with generic social fear as the object.
topics.reason: The verb takes the explicit accusative divine object and shares the plural addressed subject with the repair command.

topics.headline: barrier against renewed rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shield/barrier image behind taqwa as a preventative guard for repaired brotherhood, while the local command remains God-oriented taqwa.
topics.reason: The root and Form VIII morphology support reflexive protection pressure without replacing the established taqwa construction.

topics.headline: surah refrain toward mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this familiar taqwa command functions here as the bridge from brother-repair to hoped mercy, within the surah's repeated ethical refrain.
topics.reason: The recurring formula and immediate purpose clause support a forward link from taqwa to mercy in this ayah.

words.gloss_range: accusative proper divine name functioning as the direct object/reference point of the taqwa imperative
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name is locally selected over generic deity sense; derivational worship/refuge/bewilderment frames remain only as background orientation pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local closing hope clause referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) completes the taqwa command as an accusative proper name, anchoring the community's self-shielding to God specifically rather than to generic caution or social success. The proper-name form resists substitution with a generic deity term, while derivational worship, refuge, and bewilderment pressures only deepen the divine orientation. Placed before {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum turḥamūna}}), the name also prepares the passive mercy close: God is named, then mercy is received without restating the agent.

topics.headline: proper object of taqwa
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is oriented to God specifically, not to diffuse moral caution.
topics.reason: The accusative proper noun is the direct object of the preceding imperative.

topics.headline: proper name over generic deity category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine name functions as a fixed proper reference, while worship, refuge, and bewildered-turning derivations remain only orientation pressure.
topics.reason: The local surface is the proper name; generic deity or compositional derivation is only background.

topics.headline: between command and mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God stands between the self-shielding command and the passive mercy hope, making the implied source of mercy contextually visible without being repeated.
topics.reason: The local sequence names God before the passive mercy verb, while same-surah formulae support a stable divine axis under changing ethical scenes.

words.gloss_range: hope/purpose particle with second-person plural suffix introducing the dependent mercy clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) opens the closing hope-purpose clause and builds the plural addressees into its grammar before the mercy verb appears. The particle keeps mercy as a hoped, dependent outcome rather than a mechanical reward for repair plus taqwa. At the boundary from 49:9, the close shifts from a third-person statement about divine love to direct address: you may be shown mercy.

topics.headline: you built into hope clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same addressed community is grammatically placed inside the hope clause as the hoped-for recipient group.
topics.reason: The attached 2mp pronoun is governed by the particle and anticipates the passive predicate.

topics.headline: mercy not automatic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repair and taqwa are directed toward mercy without turning mercy into a guaranteed transaction.
topics.reason: The particle supports hope and purpose while preserving contingency under divine discretion.

topics.headline: command sequence lands in mercy hope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's specific commands are generalized into a mercy horizon, shifting from 49:9's divine-love report to direct second-person hope.
topics.reason: The final clause position and boundary row support a register shift and closing result function.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural passive imperfect under the hope particle: you may be shown mercy
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, compassion, womb-kinship, and intensive mercy attributes are narrowed here to received mercy, with the womb image answering the sibling field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preceding hope particle referenced in prose

words.prose: {{ar:تُرْحَمُونَ}} ({{tr:turḥamūna}}) closes the ayah with passive reception: the addressed community may be shown mercy, while the mercy-giving agent is grammatically unspoken though God has just been named. The passive imperfect under {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) keeps the outcome open and dependent, not already secured. From {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}), the mercy field includes womb-compassion, so the final word answers the earlier sibling language: repaired brotherhood ends in hoped received kinship-compassion, not merely in successful conflict management.

topics.headline: agent unspoken, outcome open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are foregrounded as recipients of mercy while the giver remains grammatically unspoken, with God contextually implied and the outcome still open.
topics.reason: The passive suppresses the agent and the imperfect under the hope particle keeps reception prospective; the community-source inference is narrowed away.

topics.headline: womb-compassion answers brotherhood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is not generic reward language only; the womb-compassion image answers the ayah's sibling predicate and completes a kinship arc.
topics.reason: The root family supports womb-compassion pressure, locally realized as received mercy that resonates with the brotherhood frame.

topics.headline: ayah lands on received mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word participates in a taqwa-to-mercy pattern and shifts from 49:9's measured justice and divine-love report into second-person received mercy.
topics.reason: The formulaic, closure, and boundary rows support the final word as the landing point of guarded reconciliation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive opening, the predicate 'brothers,' and the fa-linked command to repair the between.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief supplies settled security, brotherhood supplies kinship and a tether, and conflict damages the interval that also connects the parties. Reconciliation restores that relational medium; the fa makes repair an entailment of believing identity rather than optional charity.

activation_trace.role: Settled security makes belief the trust substrate that conflict endangers.
Kinship turns the disputants into relations whose bond survives disagreement.
The tether image makes brotherhood an operative bond rather than a resemblance.
Removal of interpersonal estrangement supplies the repair action.
The connection between parties identifies the relation itself as the repair site.

changed_reading.before: Believers happen to be brothers and should settle their quarrels.
changed_reading.after: The identity 'believers' names a trust-bearing tether whose damaged between the community is obligated to restore.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repair is followed by protective caution toward God and then by hoped-for mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse sequences relational repair, the erection of a protective barrier, and hoped-for tenderness. Mercy does not dissolve boundaries: guarded conduct preserves the conditions in which kinship can receive mercy.

activation_trace.role: Restoring soundness initiates the sequence by opposing relational corruption.
A barrier that wards off harm makes caution protective rather than merely fearful.
Self-placement in caution assigns each addressee responsibility for maintaining the barrier.
Tender mercy is the hoped-for condition beyond guarded repair.
The kinship branch loops the promised mercy back into the brother relation.

changed_reading.before: Fear God after making peace so that God may reward you with mercy.
changed_reading.after: Protective God-conscious conduct keeps repaired kinship habitable; mercy is the enclosing condition hoped for, not a substitute for boundaries.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A plural believing collective is named as siblings, while the concrete breach is dual and the repair command remains plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse scales from the whole collective to a two-sided interface and back to the wider addressees. The pair owns the dispute, but the surrounding community owns responsibility for repairing the middle and preserving its connection.

activation_trace.role: Repeated sibling language carries one collective identity into the concrete pair.
The middle interval localizes where a collective fracture becomes actionable.
The connecting tie keeps the localized pair attached to the larger body.
Reconciliation supplies the collective action applied to the dyadic breach.

changed_reading.before: Two disputants privately need to make up.
changed_reading.after: Every pairwise rupture is a live interface in the collective, so the plural community bears a repair duty without erasing the pair's distinct sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence checks forward advance, elevated voice, access across an enclosure, and impatience. Activated against the repair command, mediation becomes a boundary-sensitive craft in which repairers first limit their own pace, volume, and access so intervention does not become another breach.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence marks premature intervention as an overstep to be restrained.
Voice elevation supplies an acoustic form of domination that can damage repair.
Deliberate lowering and withholding model the mediator's self-limitation.
An enclosed place makes access and relational boundaries materially visible.
Holding the self against panic supplies the temporal discipline of waiting.
The focus command is the action whose method is revised by the restraint sequence.

structural_cues: 49:1-5 move from not advancing through voice control and chamber boundaries to waiting before the focus repair command.
The focus command addresses a plural audience, leaving room for the preceding discipline to govern would-be mediators.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered restraint sequence and concrete boundary images; I infer that this discipline governs how the plural addressees mediate in 49:10. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns prophetic etiquette only and does not generalize to reconciliation.

changed_reading.before: Repair means stepping in decisively to stop a quarrel.
changed_reading.after: Repair first disciplines the intervener: do not outrun authority, amplify yourself, invade an enclosure, or force timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: An incoming report is followed by making matters appear clearly, lest impulsive ignorance strike people and leave regret. The shared B-Y-N field turns the focus 'between' from a gap to close quickly into a relation that must first be made intelligible.

activation_trace.role: A delivered report supplies the uncertain informational input to conflict.
Appearance and disclosure turn verification into the first repair operation.
Disturbed forbearance shows ignorance as reactive volatility, not only missing data.
Regret supplies the irreversible cost of acting before clarification.
The focus connection is what premature, unverified action would damage.
Reconciliation becomes the downstream operation after facts are exposed.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders report, clarification, possible injury, and regret as a causal sequence.
B-Y-N occurs as clarification in 49:6 and as the relational middle in 49:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the report-to-regret sequence and two B-Y-N realizations; I infer a procedural arrow from disclosure to sound reconciliation. A live alternative is that verification governs only sanctions, while ordinary mediation could proceed without this epistemic phase.

changed_reading.after: Sound reconciliation first clears what happened; closing an opaque gap can preserve error and injure the very connection being repaired.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith is made beloved and beautiful within hearts, then named as gift, while wisdom includes restraint for correction. The focus brotherhood therefore has an affective engine: repair externalizes a divinely formed attraction to trust and aversion to corruption rather than merely enforcing a label.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding love supplies the attraction that can draw parties back toward trust.
Making goodness appear beautiful supplies positive affective formation, not bare compliance.
The heart locates that formation in the inward center from which social conduct proceeds.
Gift and beneficence prevent repaired disposition from becoming self-authored merit.
Restraint that turns back for correction gives formed desire a governing edge.
Trusting assent anchors the inward formation back in the focus identity.

structural_cues: 49:7 uses causative affective verbs around faith, hearts, aversion, and right guidance; 49:8 calls the result gift and favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward love, adornment, aversion, and gift; I infer that this affective formation enables the outward repair duty. A live alternative is that 49:7-8 describes guidance generally without specifying reconciliation as its expression.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood is a legal category that imposes reconciliation from outside.
changed_reading.after: The category has an inward motor: repaired social conduct manifests a gifted desire for trust and a trained aversion to corrupting the bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding case begins with mutual fighting, but once one side crosses the limit the community confronts that side until it returns; only then is the between repaired with justice and equity. Brotherhood survives violence, yet it cannot be used to flatten agency or demand symmetrical concessions from aggressor and injured party.

activation_trace.role: Combat between sides supplies both the initial mutual conflict and the later coercive intervention.
Repeated removal of estrangement brackets the accountability phase without replacing it.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies a non-symmetrical source of harm.
Return and turning back define the transition from resistance to renewed settlement.
Justice in judgment governs the second reconciliation rather than equalized blame.
Equity gives repaired order an affirmative measure beyond mere cessation.
Focus kinship remains the status carried through, not the excuse for, unresolved aggression.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats repair of the between before and after a conditional anti-aggression intervention.
Justice and equity explicitly qualify the post-return repair, and 49:10 immediately generalizes brotherhood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional sequence and its justice terms; I infer that 49:10 compresses that procedure into its general command. A live alternative is that 49:10 restates only the desired endpoint, leaving the preceding coercive procedure exceptional.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood asks a neutral mediator to split the difference and restore harmony.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood preserves both parties' membership while justice may require taking a side against active aggression until return makes equitable reconciliation possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ridicule reduces another, faulting pushes a defect into view, yet the object is grammatically 'yourselves.' Beside focus brotherhood, interpersonal speech becomes reflexive injury: degrading a brother damages the speaker's own collective self and reopens the repaired tether.

activation_trace.role: Mockery supplies the social act that lowers a fellow member for laughter.
Faulting by insinuation supplies a speech wound aimed through another's defect.
The very self or identity makes the outward insult fold back into collective self-injury.
The focus tether explains how injury to another returns through the shared bond.

structural_cues: 49:11 says not to fault 'yourselves' while regulating one group's treatment of another.
The branchless roots at 49:11 words 27-28 add reciprocal nicknaming and labels only as structural cues; no branch identifiers are assigned to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interpersonal prohibitions with a reflexive object; I infer that 49:10's sibling bond makes the reflexive wording socially literal. A live alternative is that the plural reflexive is simply an idiom for 'one another' without a shared-self model.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood mainly matters when an overt dispute needs mediation.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood makes ordinary status speech self-referential: contempt for another member is damage within one's own relational identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Suspicion becomes covert tracing, absent-person speech, and finally consumptive corruption of a brother. This ordered escalation moves the focus command upstream: protective caution guards the bond's information ecology before antagonism becomes a visible fight requiring settlement.

activation_trace.role: Bad suspicion supplies the unverified inward seed of relational damage.
Secret pursuit of reports turns suspicion into covert acquisition.
Mentioning a person in absence turns hidden information into social circulation.
Corruption through tale-bearing makes consumption a mechanism that spreads damage between people.
The repeated tether identifies precisely what predatory speech consumes.
The repeated protective barrier answers the escalation with preventive guarding.
The focus settlement is expanded from an after-crisis act into an upstream maintenance practice.

structural_cues: 49:12 orders suspicion, spying, backbiting, the dead-brother flesh image, aversion, protective caution, return, and mercy.
The focus and 49:12 repeat brotherhood, protective caution, God, and mercy in closely related sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered prohibitions and the consumption simile; I supply an upstream causal arrow from suspicious inference to bond-consuming circulation. A live alternative is that the offenses are parallel violations rather than stages in one escalation.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation begins after two sides openly fall out.
changed_reading.after: Reconciliation also means preventing conflict by governing suspicion, covert inquiry, and absent-person speech before they consume the brotherly bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Peoples branch apart and can also mend a fissure; tribes are groups facing one another; recognition distinguishes by signs. The focus brotherhood therefore need not flatten social difference: repair turns differentiated branches toward face-to-face recognition, while protective caution displaces inherited rank as the measure of honor.

activation_trace.role: Branching and dispersal preserve real plurality within the social field.
Mending a fissure makes reunion compatible with prior branching.
Facing one thing toward another supplies encounter without collapse into sameness.
Recognition through trace or sign makes difference intelligible rather than hostile.
Honor supplies the status measure that the verse relocates away from group pedigree.
Self-placing caution becomes the alternative criterion of worth.
The focus tie permits distinct parties to remain connected across their middle.

structural_cues: 49:13 moves from one created pair to peoples and tribes, then to mutual recognition and a non-genealogical honor criterion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching, facing, recognition, honor, and caution; I infer that these specify what repaired brotherhood does with difference. A live alternative is that 49:13's universal human plurality should not be mapped directly onto the narrower believer relation in 49:10.

changed_reading.before: Brotherly reconciliation restores unity by minimizing distinctions.
changed_reading.after: Reconciliation can preserve branching identities, reorient them face to face, and convert difference into mutual recognition under a non-pedigree measure of worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim to belief is contradicted, outward submission is available, and faith is pictured as not yet having entered hearts. This weakens a flat reading of the focus noun as a self-certified badge: 'believers are brothers' can function as a norm and diagnostic whose settled trust must become inwardly real.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent is the contested state across claim, negation, and not-yet-entered faith.
External safety and freedom from harm supply a real but incomplete social threshold.
Entry into an interior turns faith from declaration into an inward arrival.
The heart supplies the interior in which trusting identity becomes operative.
Settled security anchors the thicker reading of the focus membership term.

structural_cues: 49:14 contrasts 'we believe,' 'you have not believed,' 'say we submit,' and faith not yet entering hearts.
The branchless 49:14 word at index 20 indicates no diminution and is retained only as structural support, without an invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit claim-versus-entry contrast; I infer that 49:10's nominal identity is normative and testable in conduct, including repair. A live alternative is that 49:14 addresses a distinct group and does not qualify the referent of 49:10 at all.

changed_reading.before: Anyone asserting the believer label automatically possesses the full brotherhood described.
changed_reading.after: The focus predicate can call a community into a trust-bearing identity whose inward reality is disclosed, and perhaps formed, by how it protects and repairs relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Belief is followed by effort under strain with wealth and selves, then by truthfulness as realized word and deed. The focus imperative is thus not exhausted by conciliatory speech: faithful repair may require material expenditure, personal risk, time, and fulfilled commitments.

activation_trace.role: Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies the cost profile of enacted belief.
Possessed resources make commitment materially spendable rather than verbal only.
The living self supplies personal exposure alongside material cost.
Realizing promise in action makes costly follow-through the proof of speech.
Making the damaged relation sound is the focus task to which effort and resources are assigned.

structural_cues: 49:15 places lack of destabilizing doubt before effort with wealth and selves and closes with a truthfulness judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly exertion and enacted truthfulness; I infer that reconciliation is one arena in which such expenditure verifies the focus identity. A live alternative is that the effort concerns a different communal duty and does not specify the cost of mediation.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation is principally a good statement or persuasive conversation.
changed_reading.after: Repair may be the costly truth of brotherhood, requiring resources, exposure, and fulfilled commitments after conciliatory words end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human beings burden the recipient by recounting their submission as a favor, while the direction reverses toward divine guidance as gift. The focus passive hope for mercy then resists mediator ownership: successful repair cannot become a moral invoice, prestige claim, or leverage over the reconciled parties.

activation_trace.role: Recounting a benefit until it burdens the recipient exposes the danger of weaponized beneficence.
Release without compensation supplies the contrasting gift logic.
A gentle gift sent toward one held in affection locates guidance outside human boasting.
Realized word and deed test whether the claimed benefit is truthful.
Hoped-for tenderness anchors the focus outcome as received mercy rather than mediator property.

structural_cues: 49:17 explicitly reverses who is conferring favor and makes guidance, not human self-presentation, the decisive gift.
The focus closes with a passive hope of receiving mercy rather than a claim that repairers manufacture it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the favor-burden and gift reversal; I infer that the same anti-leverage rule governs those who facilitate 49:10 repair. A live alternative is that 49:17 rebukes boasting about submission only, without addressing mediators.

changed_reading.before: The successful peacemaker earns standing over those helped.
changed_reading.after: Repair must remain non-possessive: it seeks mercy and guides gently without converting restored peace into debt owed to the mediator.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes social ethics as tether, barrier, gap, and womb; it remains valid because every component is branch-backed in the focus ayah. Render it only as an exploratory model of protected relational space, not as a claim that the verse literally calls the community a womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Brother tether, the between, protective caution, and mercy all occur in the focus sequence.

activation_trace.role: A tether gives the sibling relation a material bond that can strain or hold.
A widened gap supplies the tear or exposed distance within the bond.
A protective barrier supplies the enclosure that prevents further injury.
The womb supplies a bounded, sustaining interior for the hoped-for mercy.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives an abstract rule about social harmony.
changed_reading.after: The verse can be carried as a material model: mend a torn tether, close its dangerous exposure, and restore a protected interior in which related lives can remain viable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a corporeal extension beyond ordinary settlement language, but 49:12 repeats the focus brother root and explicitly supplies eating, flesh, death, and kinship-tissue branches. Render it as the packet's severe metaphor for absent-person harm, not as an ontology of the community or a literal ritual prescription.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names believers as brothers and commands repair of their connecting middle; 49:12 returns to the brother as consumable flesh.

activation_trace.role: Focus kinship supplies the living relation later exposed to consumption.
Literal taking of food gives absent speech its predatory action.
Woven fabric makes flesh a model for the interlaced tissue of relation.
Kinship cohesion directly links bodily tissue to the brother bond.
Loss of force and life marks the absent brother's inability to answer or defend the bond.

changed_reading.before: Repair reconnects two autonomous speakers after disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood also obliges protection of the absent and voiceless: predatory speech consumes the woven kinship tissue that reconciliation would otherwise have to regrow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is deliberately branch-distant: it uses the packet's non-dominant H-D-D mapping beside dominant H-D-Y to contrast severe breaking with soothing a child. It remains anchored through the focus commands to restore soundness and seek tenderness, but downstream prose must label it a split-root heuristic, never a lexical equivalence for guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Restoring soundness and hoped-for tenderness in 49:10 can be tested against the opposed guidance, breaking, and gentling images activated at 49:17.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path supplies the dominant directional mode.
Severe breaking supplies the destructive pole that repair must avoid or contain.
Soothing rhythmic gentling supplies a non-destructive way to settle agitation.
Restored soundness anchors the contrast in the focus repair action.
Tender mercy selects gentling over person-breaking as the hoped-for horizon.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation ends conflict by imposing a settlement.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory split-root reading asks whether repair guides agitated parties toward truth by gentling their motion without breaking the persons being corrected.

strongest_changes: 49:6 makes disclosure and affective steadiness prerequisites to closing the relational gap.
49:9 blocks false neutrality: brotherhood survives conflict while just repair may oppose the aggressing side until return.
49:11-12 move repair upstream into reflexive speech, suspicion, covert inquiry, and protection of the absent brother.
49:14-17 complicate membership and merit: faith must become inward and enacted, costly repair does not become the repairer's moral property.
summary.what_was_special: The restrictive identity claim, plural-to-dual grammar, and elastic 'between' make 49:10 a compressed social protocol. Context activation did not collapse into one reading: epistemic, judicial, affective, boundary, pluralist, corporeal, and gift-based mechanisms remain simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer of 49:1-5 prophetic etiquette to mediation is coherent but analogical.
49:14 may qualify the focus membership term normatively, or may concern a separate group without narrowing 49:10.
The womb-tether and H-D-Y/H-D-D models are useful material heuristics but should not be promoted into lexical claims.
The knowledge and visibility cues in 49:16 and 49:18 sharpen hidden accountability but did not produce a distinct retained model beyond the stronger information and non-ownership readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Brotherhood is a tethered relation requiring maintenance.** ء خ و B001 gives kinship and B002 a tethering bond; ب ي ن B003 gives the tie between parties; ص ل ح B001/B002 gives soundness and reconciliation. The packet repeats "brothers" around the repair command. I infer that brotherhood names an operative bond that can slacken or break and therefore imposes maintenance, not a sentimental description.
2. **Repair restores fitness to the interval.** ص ل ح B003 (suitability or fitness) and ب ي ن B011 (an intermediate state between two ends) make *bayna akhawaykum* a worked relational space. The syntax supplies repair in-between. I infer that conflict deforms this interval and reconciliation makes it usable again. The object of repair is neither brother alone but the shared middle.
3. **Guarding the bond opens kinship-mercy.** و ق ي B001 supplies a protective barrier and ر ح م B002 the kinship bond alongside tenderness B001. The command -> hoped-for mercy sequence is explicit. I infer that *taqwā* protects the relational conditions in which kin-like mercy can circulate. Mercy is not detached reward but the bond's renewed function.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 49:11's reflexive *anfusakum* and 49:12's flesh of a brother made the tether unexpectedly bodily: injury to another travels through a shared self and shared tissue. 49:13 then widened this bond beyond the immediate believing community by grounding differentiated peoples in one measured origin.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Brotherhood is a binding obligation that conflict strains but does not dissolve.** `ء خ و:B001` supplies brotherhood and kinship, while `ء خ و:B002` images a tether-loop, protected bond, or covenant. `ب ي ن:B003` similarly names the tie connecting parties, and `ص ل ح:B002` removes hostility between them. The two fighting groups in 49:9 remain believers, and 49:11–12 translate injury to another into injury to **yourselves** and consumption of a brother. The packet gives kinship, tether, and these reciprocal constructions; I infer that **إِخْوَةٌ** imposes a bond whose maintenance is constitutive of communal faith.

2. **The object of repair is the relation itself.** The construction **فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ** anchors repair in `ب ي ن:B003`, the shared connection, rather than only in two isolated actors; its dormant opposite `ب ي ن:B001` is separation after connection. The later chain of mockery, fault-finding, labels, suspicion, spying, and backbiting (49:11–12) identifies mechanisms that corrode this relational interval. The packet supplies both branches and those later attacks; I infer that reconciliation must rebuild the communicative and reputational space through which brothers remain joined. The command therefore exceeds ending overt combat.

3. **Protective caution is the human side of a kinship-shaped mercy.** `و ق ي:B002` places the self in moral protection, and `ر ح م:B001` supplies mercy; but `ر ح م:B002` also supplies kinship bonds and `ر ح م:B003` the womb. Brotherhood here, the dead brother’s flesh in 49:12, and creation from male and female in 49:13 make those dormant relational branches visible. The packet gives the lexical images but not identity among them; I infer that guarding God’s boundary protects a shared life imagined as emerging from and sustained by kinship. **لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ** thus reads as entry into mercy by preserving the vulnerable bond that mercy itself images.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 49:13 widens the kinship substrate: common measured creation from male and female activates `ر ح م:B003` without erasing this ayah’s specific believer-brotherhood. The surprise is layered relation: covenantal brotherhood (`ء خ و:B002`) rests inside a more universal created dependence.

baseline.text: İnananlar ancak kardeştir. Öyleyse iki kardeşinizin arasını düzeltin ve Allah'a karşı gelmekten sakının ki size merhamet edilsin.

findings.text: Kardeşlik, çatışmayla yok olmayan fakat gerilip kopabildiği için bakım ve onarım yükümlülüğü doğuran bağlı bir ilişkidir.
Barıştırmanın nesnesi yalnız iki kişi değil, aralarında iletişim ve itibarın dolaştığı ortak ilişkisel alandır.
Allah'a karşı sakınma, merhameti soyut bir ödül olmaktan çıkarıp kardeşlik bağını yeniden işler kılan korumadır.
Rahim imgesinden hareketle inananların kardeşliğini bütün insanların ortak yaratılış bağı içine yerleştirmek mümkündür; ancak bu genişletme ayette doğrudan kurulmaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Right relation consists in taking a governed direction: not moving ahead of the guide, accepting restraint, and returning after deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance is embodied as procession, measured travel, bridle, tether, city, and road geometry, so obedience appears as coordinated motion rather than passive immobility.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Bridle, Tether, and Handover
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Forceful independent motion is brought into alignment through restraint, attachment, and voluntary handover.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intellect that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`; camel tether `quranic:root_001036:B002/m01`; held tongue `quranic:root_001036:B003/m01`; handover and surrender `quranic:root_000737:B012/m01`; submission under another's hand `quranic:root_001693:B006/m01`; bridle that restrains and corrects `quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`; tether or binding tie `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: reason/tether occurs at 49:4; the hand root at 49:1; wisdom and restraint at 49:8; the brother/tie root at 49:10 and 12; surrender at 49:14 and 17.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These senses materialize governed obedience without collapsing it into compulsion. Intellect, tongue, animal motion, and social relation are each held by an appropriate restraint. Bridle and tether check direction, while handover yields control, explaining how external surrender can be real alignment while remaining distinct from inward faith.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What enters or leaves the mouth can violate a protected relation and spread corruption through a social or bodily organism.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Backbiting is pressured by veterinary pathology, burial, shared bodily tissue, and a concealed spark that turns circulating talk into social fire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Consuming the Absent Brother
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech about an absent relative is enacted as stripping and eating flesh from a dead body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: mentioning an absent person `quranic:root_001117:B004/m01`; burial that removes a body from sight `quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`; eating `quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`; flesh or meat `quranic:root_001348:B001/m01`; stripping flesh from bone `quranic:root_001348:B009/m01`; kinship tissue `quranic:root_001348:B007/m01`; death `quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`; carrion `quranic:root_001454:B007/m01`; brotherhood `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:10, 12, and 18.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The comparison forms a complete bodily scene. Absence and burial remove the victim from answer and sight, death removes resistance, and kinship makes the consumed flesh one's own social tissue. The stripping sense intensifies the operation: backbiting dismantles the body that carries the bond.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Faulting the Other Injures the Shared Self
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A fault first held within the self becomes a verbal or bodily jab against a brother who belongs to the same social tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: self as the very same entity `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; inward intention and thought `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; faulting or slanderous speech `quranic:root_001376:B001/m01`; physical or verbal jab `quranic:root_001376:B002/m01`; brotherhood `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; flesh as kinship tissue `quranic:root_001348:B007/m01`; self or life `quranic:root_001533:B011/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: the cited evidence roots occur at 49:10, 11, 12, and 15.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The plural self in 49:11 is materialized as shared tissue. An inward judgment crosses into a jab, but its target remains part of the same brotherly body. Faulting another is therefore reflexive injury rather than an attack that leaves the speaker's own social self intact.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem guven halini hem de guvenilirlik ve emanet iliskisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun giderilmesi ve ic yatiskinligi onde oldugunda dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Korku karsiti guven halini korur.
error_profile.loses: Emanet, guvenilirlik ve guven verme boyutlarini disarida birakir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin baskasini koruma ve teminat altina almasi anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bir baskasina guven saglama iliskisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Guven icinde bulunma ve guvenilirlik adlandirmalarini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kisi, emanet ya da dayanikli nesne guvenilirlik niteliginde anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Guvenilir sayilma ve emanet edilebilir olma tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Korkudan emin olma halini ve guven verme eylemini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogru sayma, ic kabul ve daha ozel dini baglanma imkanini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Vaatle ilgili dogrulama tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tasdik ve dini kabullenme alanlarini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali dua icinde soylenen bir kabul istegi sozu ve bu sozu soyleme eylemi olarak verir. Cerceve, guven ve tasdik dallarindan ayrildigi ve sadece dua cevabi formuluyle ilgili oldugu icin uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik ya da tasdik degil; duada kabul talebini bildiren sabit sozdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal belirli bir dua sozu ve onu soyleme eylemiyle sinirlidir; buradan genel guven ya da tasdik anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak dali dua icinde soylenen ve kabul istegi tasiyan sabit bir soz olarak anlatir. Ayni iddia, bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve sozun anlamina dair 'kabul et' ya da 'oyle olsun' aciklamalarini da icerir; ad yorumu ise bu ortak malzemenin yan aktarimidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın merkezini erkek ve kadın kardeş ile kardeşlik ilişkisi olarak doğrular. Arkadaşlar için kullanılan çoğul biçim, doğumdan gelen kardeşlikle aynı düzeyde bir temel anlam değil, kardeşlik benzetmesine dayanan bir kullanım eğilimidir; birini kardeş edinme ise yalnızca ayrı sözlü yapılarda gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğum ve soy bağına dayanan kardeşliği merkez alır; arkadaşlık ve sonradan kardeş sayma kullanımları bu merkeze bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi ve ilişki adları ile belirli sözlü yapılar birlikte bulunduğundan, temel kardeşlik anlamı bu yapılara özgü edinme ve karşılıklı bağ kurma anlamlarıyla birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı doğum veya soy bağı içinde erkek ya da kadın kardeş olma ve bu kişileri adlandırma alanıdır. Arkadaşların kardeş sayılması, temel soy bağının arkadaşlığa benzetilerek genişletilmiş bir kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Temel alan, erkek ve kadın kardeşleri ve aralarındaki doğum ya da soy bağını kapsar.
Çoğul biçimlerden biri daha çok doğumdan kardeşler, diğeri ise daha çok arkadaşlar için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar erkek kardeş adının tarihsel biçimini ve kadın kardeş adının dişil karşılığını birlikte temellendirir. Ayrıca çoğul adlandırmada, doğumdan kardeşlerle arkadaşlık yoluyla kardeş sayılan kişiler arasında baskın bir kullanım ayrımı bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem doğumdan gelen kardeşlik bağını hem de bu bağa benzetilerek kardeş sayılan kişileri topluca anlatırken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kardeşlik bağını, kardeş kişileri ve benzetmeye dayalı genişlemeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir erkek ya da kadın kardeşten söz edilen doğal metin bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Çoğul biçimler arasındaki kullanım eğilimini ve arkadaşlara uzanan genişlemeyi göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğumdan kardeş olan birden çok kişiyi ya da bağlam açık olduğunda kardeş gibi görülen arkadaşları anlatır.

error_profile.loses: Kaynakta ayrı çoğul biçimlerle belirtilen doğum ve arkadaşlık kullanım eğilimini tek başına belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hayvanın bağlandığı halka veya bağı hem de gözetilmesi gereken dokunulmaz ilişki ve yükümlülük anlamını açıkça verir. İkinci anlam, fiziksel bağlama aracına eşitlenmeden, korunması gereken bağın soyut uzantısı olarak ayrı tutulabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel bağlama noktasını merkez alır ve gözetilen hak ya da yükümlülük bağını ayrı bir uzantı olarak korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad biçimleri hem fiziksel hem soyut anlam taşırken, bağlama eylemi yalnızca belirtilen hayvan bağlama yapısına özgüdür ve genel bir bağlamak anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir hayvanın tutturulduğu halka, bağ veya sabit bağlama noktasıdır. Aynı ad, gözetilmesi gereken dokunulmaz bir ilişkiyi, hakkı ya da yükümlülük bağını da belirtir.

facets.statement: Fiziksel anlam, hayvanın kendisine bağlandığı halka, bağ veya sabit tutturma noktasını belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimlerdeki iyi ve düzgün olma çekirdeğini, düzeltme türevlerini ve yalnızca belirli yapıda görülen iyi davranma kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durumdur. Bu eksen kişinin ve işin iyi olmasını, bir şeyi düzeltmeyi, yarar sağlayan şeyi, iyi duruma getirmeyi istemeyi ve özel bir yapıda hayvana iyi davranmayı kapsar; insanın iyi yaratılması, bozukluğunun giderilmesi veya iyi sayılması da düzeltmenin farklı gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem durum ve duruma gelme çekirdeğini hem de bozukluğu gidererek iyi duruma getirme işlemini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İyi ve düzgün durum, bu duruma gelme ve bu durumu sağlama ayrımlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, iş veya şeyin bozuk olmayan durumunu ya da bu duruma gelmesini anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İyi ve düzgün durumda bulunma ya da bu duruma gelme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi bu duruma getirme işlemini ve özel yapıdaki iyi davranma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir etkenin kişi, iş veya şeydeki bozukluğu gidererek onu iyi duruma getirdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozukluğu giderme ve iyi duruma getirme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendiliğinden iyi durumda olmayı ve özel yapıdaki iyi davranma kullanımını karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kaynakta verilen yönelme yapısının bir hayvana yönelik iyi davranışı anlattığı bağlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Özel yapının iyi davranma anlamını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Dalın genel iyi durum ve düzeltme çekirdeğini temsil etmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayımlanan beş karşılaştırma, dal içi karışmaları, temel karşıtlığı, alanla sınırlı yakın anlamı ve genel iyilikle sınır farkını gösterir; kalan adaylar ya yalnızca örnek, özel alan veya ortak senaryo paylaşır ya da kişi ve yer adı dalları olarak anlamsal çekirdeği kesmez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه صلاح الشيء والرجل والعمل، والإصلاح نقيض الإفساد، والمصلحة والاستصلاح، والإحسان في مثل أصلحت إلى الدابة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uzaklık ve soğukluğun giderilmesini karşılıklı barışma ve uzlaşmayla açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu kişiler arası sınırı korur ve genel anlamdaki iyi olma ya da bir nesneyi düzeltme anlamını bu dala taşımadığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanlar arasındaki soğukluk, çatışma veya uzaklığın barışmayla giderilmesini kapsar; genel düzgünlük ve nesne onarımı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın kişiler arası barışma çekirdeğine dayanır ve başka dallardaki genel iyi olma, düzeltme veya uygunluk anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluk, uzaklık veya çatışmanın giderilerek tarafların karşılıklı biçimde barışması ve uzlaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı insanların kendi aralarında barışması ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir; ad ve eylem biçimleri aynı karşılıklı uzlaşma olayını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluğun veya çatışmanın giderilip karşılıklı barışın kurulmasını eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiler arası olumsuz ilişkinin giderilmesini ve tarafların karşılıklı uzlaşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış tarafların yeniden iyi ilişki kurduğu bağlamlarda doğal bir açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki olumsuz ilişkiyi, bunun giderilmesini ve karşılıklı barışmayı birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: barışma, uzlaşma ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarafların birbirinden yüz çevirmesi, ilişkiyi kesmesi ve uzaklaşması komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişiler arasındaki yakınlık veya uzaklık durumunu ve ilişkinin sürmesini konu edinir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. Geçici çerçeve uygunluk ilişkisini doğru saptamış ve ahlaki iyilik ya da bozukluğu düzeltme anlamlarını bu dala katmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca verilen kişi yönelimli yapıda bir şeyin o kişiye uymasıdır; yalın bir iyi olma veya genel düzeltme anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun olduğunu bildiren kalıba bağlıdır; bu kullanım yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yapıda, bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun düşmesi, ona uyması ve onun alanından sayılmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı ifade, belirli bir şeyin muhataba uygun olduğunu onun alanından veya türünden sayılma açıklamasıyla verir; anlam bütünüyle bu kişi yönelimli yapıya bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalda kişi adı olarak kalıplaşmış biçimlerle sınırlıdır; genel niteleme, yer adı veya başka ad türleri bu dala katılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ayrılma, kopma ve birbirinden uzak düşme çevresinde kurar. Geçici çerçeve bunu sadık biçimde karşılar; sözlü açıklık veya yer aralığı anlamları bu dalın çekirdeğine taşınmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal, birleşme veya yakınlık sonrasında ortaya çıkan ayrılma ve kopma alanıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım herhangi bir özel kalıptan alınan boşluk, zaman veya söz açıklığı anlamını ithal etmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da tarafların önceki bağlantı, birliktelik veya yakınlıktan ayrılması, kopması ve birbirinden uzak düşmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam ayrılma, kopma ve tarafların birbirinden ayrı hale gelmesidir.
Ayrılık taraflar arasında uzaklaşma veya karşılıklı ayrışma biçiminde de anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda ayrılma ve kopma çekirdeğinde birleşir; bazı anlatımlar kesme yönünü, bazıları ise ayrışma ve uzaklaşma yönünü öne çıkarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birlik, temas veya yakınlık sonrasında gerçekleşen ayrılma çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrılma, kopma ve bağdan çıkma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarafların karşılıklı ayrıştığı sosyal, mekansal veya soyut bağlamlarda doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı ayrılma ve uzak düşme yönünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda ana çekirdek bağdan ayrılmadır; komşuda ana çekirdek yakın olmama ve uzak yerde bulunmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da taraflar arasındaki ilişkiyi konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkiyi koparan ayrışmayı verir; komşu dal taraflar arasındaki konum veya mesafeyi verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık ve iç bölge fikrini verir. Geçici çerçeve, eldeki kalıpları da ayrı kullanım olarak sakladığı sürece bu dalı doğru temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ayrılık eylemi değil, taraflar arasındaki konum, aralık veya kapsanan iç topluluk alanıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam karma yapıdadır; yalın ara-konum çekirdeği ile belirli kalıplardaki yakınlık ve içinden olma kullanımları ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: İki veya daha çok taraf arasında kalan orta, aralık, mesafe ya da iç konumdur; bazı kalıplarda birine yakın veya bir topluluğun içinden olma anlamına bağlanır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki veya daha çok taraf arasındaki orta, aralık ve iç konumdur.
Belirli kalıplarda birinin önünde, yanında veya yakınında bulunma anlamı doğar.
Bir topluluğun içinden veya o topluluğa dahil bir unsur olarak seçilmeyi anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar orta ve aralık çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca kullanımın iki veya daha çok tarafı gerektirdiği ve bazı kalıplarda yakınlık ya da içinden olma verdiği anlaşılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ona zarar verecek başka bir şeyden korumayı ve bunun için araya koruyucu bir unsur koymayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Koruyucu bez örneği bu genel işlemin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir ve dalın kimliğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel koruma işlemini ve koruyucu aracı kapsar; kişinin kendini sakınması, ağırlık ölçüsü, hayvanın aksaması ve kuş adı bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel koruma çekirdeğini özel ad ve kalıplardan ayırır; kadına ait koruyucu bez yalnızca yapıya bağlı bir örnek olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ona zarar verecek başka bir şeyden korumak için araya bir araç ya da engel koyma ve böylece zararı ondan uzak tutma. Bu işlevi gören araç veya engel de aynı kavram alanında adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Korunan şeyden zarar verici etkiyi uzak tutma ve onu incinmekten ya da bozulmaktan saklama işlemidir.
Koruma, zarar ile korunacak şey arasına başka bir araç, katman veya engel koyularak gerçekleştirilir.
Kadının saçı ile dış örtüsü arasına koyduğu bez, bu koruyucu ara katmanın özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, korumayı zararlı etkiyi başka bir şey aracılığıyla savma olarak kurar; hem koruma eylemini hem de bu işte kullanılan engeli kapsar. Kadının saçını dış örtüden ayıran bez, bu mekanizmanın özel bir örneğidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel eylem ile koruyucu aracın ortak çekirdeğini, herhangi bir özel kullanım alanına bağlamadan karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Zararı uzak tutma işlemini ve araya koruyucu bir unsur koyma mekanizmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden çok, zarar ile korunacak şey arasına koyulan araç veya katman kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin kendisini korktuğu şeyden koruma altına almasını ve yanlış davranıştan uzak tutmasını aynı öz-koruma şemasında birleştirir. Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma bu çekirdeğin inanç alanındaki belirgin gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kişinin kendisini koruması ve sakınmasıyla sınırlıdır; herhangi bir nesneyi koruma, yalnız başına iyi iş yapma veya işlenmiş yanlıştan dönme anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel öz-koruma anlamı ile bir aracı kendine koruyucu yapma ve Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma kalıpları ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisini korktuğu veya zarar beklediği şeyden koruyacak bir önlem altına alması ve yanlış davranıştan uzak tutması. Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma, bu öz-koruma tutumunun inanç alanındaki özel biçimidir.

facets.statement: Kişi, korkulan ya da zarar verecek şey ile kendi arasına koruyucu bir önlem koyar.
Öz-koruma, kişiyi suç doğuran ve yanlış sayılan davranışlardan uzak tutma biçimini alabilir.
Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınma, kişi ile sakınılan sonuç arasına koruyucu bir tutum koymak olarak düşünülür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalı, kişinin kendisini korkulan şey karşısında koruma altına alması ve yanlış davranıştan uzak tutması olarak açıklar. İnanç bağlamındaki kullanım, Tanrı'ya karşı gelmekten sakınmayı kişi ile kötü sonuç arasındaki koruyucu tutum şeklinde somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca toynak ağrısından kaçınmayı değil, hafif topallamayı, topallayan atın davranışını, hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri ve aksayışa göre davranma sözünü birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek hafif topallama ve ağrılı ya da hassas toynak yüzünden sakınarak yürümedir; eyer, emir ve sert zemin kullanımları bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek sözcüklü hafif topallama anlamı, atın yürüyüşü ile eyer ve emir kalıplarına bağlı anlamlardan açıkça ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Hafif topallama ile, özellikle toynak ağrısı veya hassasiyeti yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atın durumu. Aynı kullanım kümesi, hayvanın aksamasına göre davranmayı, sert zeminden yakınmamayı ve hayvanda yara açmayan eyeri de anlatır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hafif topallamayı çekirdek yapar ve bunu topallayan, toynak ağrısı yüzünden yürümekten çekinen ya da sert zeminde ayağını sakınan atla açımlar. Aksamaya göre davranma, sert zeminden yakınmama ve yara açmayan eyer kullanımları aynı kümede yer alan fakat çekirdeğe bağımlı yan kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bilinen bir ağırlık ölçüsü olarak doğrular, ancak tek ve değişmez bir nicelik vermez. Bir kullanım kırk gümüş para ağırlığını, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimini gösterir; tanım bu bağlam farkını açıkça korumalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca bu adlandırılmış ağırlık ölçüsü ve onun biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; genel tartma eylemine, her türlü miktara veya modern bir ölçü adına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki sözcük biçimine bağlı farklı ölçü değerlerini ve çoğul biçimleri ayırır; bunlardan genel bir kök anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına, başındaki ses düşmüş başka bir biçim ve kullanımda ise yağ için yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit kabul edilen ölçü. İlk biçim daha düzgün sayılır ve birden çok çoğul biçimi vardır.

facets.statement: Temel biçim, belirli bir ağırlık ölçüsüdür ve para hesabında kırk gümüş paranın ağırlığına eşitlenir.
Başındaki ses düşmüş biçim, yağ ölçümünde kullanılan ve yedi temel ağırlık birimine eşit sayılan ayrı bir değeri bildirir.
Başlangıç sesini koruyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir ve ölçü adının iki çoğul söylenişi kaydedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, aynı ölçü ailesinde bağlama ve sözcük biçimine göre iki değer aktarır: para hesabında kırk gümüş para ağırlığı ve yağ hesabında yedi temel ağırlık birimi. Başlangıç sesini taşıyan biçim daha düzgün kabul edilir; ölçü adının iki çoğul biçimi de verilir.

concept_gloss.text: kırk gümüş para ağırlığındaki, yağda yedi birimlik biçimi bulunan ölçü

error_profile.preserves: Ağırlık ölçüsü olmasını, para hesabındaki kırk sayısını ve yağ hesabındaki yedi birimlik değişkeyi korur.
